actions.name: obtained initial access via exploitation of an Internet-facing Microsoft SharePoint
actions.description: Initial access was obtained via exploitation of an Internet-facing Microsoft SharePoint, exploiting CVE-2019-0604.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: maintained persistence using several .aspx webshells
actions.description: After obtaining access to the victim environment, the actors used several .aspx webshells, pickers.aspx, error4.aspx, ClientBin.aspx, to maintain persistence.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: conducted lateral movement using RDP, SMB, and FTP
actions.description: During this timeframe, the actors also used RDP (primarily), SMB, and FTP for lateral movement throughout the victim environment.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: used a compromised Microsoft Exchange account to run mailbox searches
actions.description: The actors used a compromised Microsoft Exchange account to run searches (via CmdLets New-MailboxSearch and Get-Recipient) on various mailboxes, including for administrator accounts.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: created a new Exchange account and added it to the Organization Management role group
actions.description: The actors used the compromised account to create a new Exchange account and add it to the Organization Management role group.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: made thousands of HTTP POST requests to Exchange servers for likely email exfiltration
actions.description: The actors made thousands of HTTP POST requests to Exchange servers of the victim organization, transferring roughly 70-160 MB of data from client and 3-20 GB from server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: connected to victim organization’s VPN appliance using two compromised accounts
actions.description: Approximately twelve months after initial access and two months before launching the destructive cyber attack, the actors made connections to IP addresses belonging to the victim organization’s VPN appliance using two compromised accounts.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: executed Advanced Port Scanner
actions.description: The actors executed the “Advanced Port Scanner” (advanced_port_scanner.exe).
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: used Mimikatz and performed LSASS dumping
actions.description: The FBI found evidence of Mimikatz usage and LSASS dumping.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: launched ransomware-style file encryptor on victim print server via RDP
actions.description: The actor logged in to a victim organization print server via RDP and kicked off a process (Mellona.exe) which propagated the GoXml.exe encryptor to internal machines along with a persistence script called win.bat.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: encrypted files on target systems with GoXml.exe
actions.description: GoXML.exe encrypted all files (except those having extensions .exe, .dll, .sys, .lnk, or .lck) on the target system, leaving behind a ransom note titled How_To_Unlock_MyFiles.txt in each folder impacted.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: executed disk wiping with Disk Wiper tool (cl.exe)
actions.description: The actors began actions that resulted in raw disk drives being wiped with the Disk Wiper tool (cl.exe).
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: performed numerous RDP connections from victim server to other hosts during wiping
actions.description: Over approximately eight hours, numerous RDP connections were logged from an identified victim server to other hosts on the victim’s network during the wiping activity.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: executed cl.exe command line during RDP sessions
actions.description: Command line execution of cl.exe was observed in cached bitmap files from these RDP sessions on the victim server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.
